summary: YC's AI Stack gives students who attend an eligible YC event (starting Fall 2025) free credits from 20 partner companies. The deals page lists $5,000 in AWS cloud credits (down from $10,000 as of 2026-10-28), $1,000 in OpenAI API credits and $500 in Anthropic API credits, plus offers from 17 YC companies such as Langfuse, Firecrawl, Vapi, Browser Use, Deepgram, Supabase and Gumloop. Until 2026-10-28 the page advertised "Over $25,000" in total; it no longer states an overall total. Access lasts one year from the qualifying event. The 2025 launch blog also mentioned Azure credits, but Azure is not listed on the current deals page.
claim_steps: Attend an eligible YC event (Fall 2025 onward), RSVPing with your Hacker News account
Watch for the confirmation email after the event
Sign in at deals.ycombinator.com/students with the same Hacker News account to check eligibility

Check each partner's current amount after sign-in: on 2026-10-29 the page listed AWS $5,000 (previously $10,000), OpenAI $1,000, Anthropic $500 and 17 YC-company offers, with no Azure deal and no stated total.
Browse and redeem each partner deal
